items.name: spawn_area respawn height intermittent

lines: -- Waits until the avatar is really at rest before its height is sampled: Humanoid.FloorMaterial is not Air,
-- the root's |vertical speed| < SPAWN_SETTLE_MAX_VY AND the root's Y has stayed within SPAWN_SETTLE_MAX_DY of
-- the previous frame for SPAWN_SETTLE_FRAMES frames in a row spanning at least SPAWN_SETTLE_MIN_S seconds (any
-- violation resets the streak), at most `timeout` seconds. A short grounded moment (top of the hip-height
-- correction, a small bounce after respawn) is therefore not "landed". On timeout it returns anyway so a
-- character that never settles still FAILS the height check.
-- Records <pre>_settle_s (seconds waited) and <pre>_settle_landed (1 landed, 0 timed out) in the metrics.
local SPAWN_SETTLE_MAX_DY = 0.05 -- studs of root Y change allowed between consecutive frames
local SPAWN_SETTLE_MIN_S = 0.2 -- the stable streak must also last this long
local streak, streakT0, lastY = 0, nil, nil
local alive = hum.Parent ~= nil and root.Parent ~= nil
local y = alive and root.Position.Y or nil
if streak >= SPAWN_SETTLE_FRAMES and os.clock() - streakT0 >= SPAWN_SETTLE_MIN_S then
-- On foot at the walk spawn, visible, able to walk and jump, not racing, no car, no run.
-- `settleTimeout` bounds the landing wait before sampling (default SPAWN_SETTLE_TIMEOUT).
local notRacing = not racing() and player:GetAttribute("AutoRacing") == false
check(checks, pre .. "_not_racing", notRacing and 1 or 0, 1, notRacing)
check(checks, pre .. "_at_walk_spawn", d, SPAWN_AT_SPAWN, d <= SPAWN_AT_SPAWN)
-- the walk spawn is in the hub, so an avatar sent there stands in the hub (not just anywhere on the floor)
local inArea = spawnInsideLocal(base, c.Root.Position, SPAWN_LAYOUT.HUB_MIN, SPAWN_LAYOUT.HUB_MAX)
check(checks, pre .. "_inside_area", inArea and 1 or 0, 1, inArea)
check(checks, pre .. "_visible", visible and 1 or 0, 1, visible)
local unseated = c.Humanoid.SeatPart == nil and c.Humanoid.Sit == false
check(checks, pre .. "_unseated", unseated and 1 or 0, 1, unseated)
